description: Base questions that determine the flow of subsequent detailed questions. These are qualifying questions that lead to specific income/deduction collection paths. Aligned with app flow: primary income source, residency, rent, health insurance, pension, mortgage, then capital gains and exemptions.

optionDescriptions.Digital Assets/Crypto: Income from crypto, digital assets, royalties, gifts, or other sources

questions.explanation: You can have multiple sources of income. Each source is taxed differently: Employment uses PAYE, business and freelance require profit/tracking, rental and investment income have specific rules, and digital assets may have separate treatment. Select all that apply.
questions.helpText: You can select more than one option.

questions.questionText: Did/Will you live in Nigeria for 183+ days this tax year?
questions.explanation: Residency determines whether you declare worldwide income or only Nigerian-sourced income for the tax year.
questions.helpText: This determines whether you declare worldwide income or only Nigerian-sourced income.

options: No, I own my home or live rent-free
questions.explanation: If you rent, you may be eligible for rent relief deduction, which reduces your taxable income.
questions.helpText: If yes, you're eligible for a 20% rent relief deduction (new in 2026). Could save you up to N500k.

questions.questionText: Do you pay for health insurance?
questions.explanation: Health insurance contributions (e.g. NHIS) are tax-deductible and reduce your taxable income.
questions.helpText: If yes, you can claim your health insurance contributions as a deduction.

questions.questionText: Do you contribute to a pension plan?
questions.explanation: Pension contributions (RSA) are tax-deductible and reduce your taxable income.
questions.helpText: If yes, you can claim your pension contributions as a deduction (up to 25% of income).

questions.explanation: Interest on loans for developing an owner-occupied residential house is tax-deductible.
questions.helpText: If yes, you can claim mortgage interest as a deduction.

questions.questionText: Do you contribute to any of the following?
questions.explanation: Contributions to NHF and Life Insurance are tax-deductible. Health and pension are already captured above.
questions.helpText: Select all that apply. These contributions can reduce the tax you pay.

questions.questionText: Did you sell or dispose of any assets during the tax year?
questions.explanation: Capital gains tax applies when you sell assets like property, shares, or other investments. Some disposals are exempt (like principal residence once in lifetime, or personal chattels under ₦5M).
questions.helpText: Answer 'Yes' if you sold any property, shares, vehicles, or other valuable assets during the tax year.

questions.questionText: Do any of these exemptions apply to you?
options: I earn minimum wage or less
I work in agricultural business (first 5 years)
I work in a combat zone or hazardous area
questions.explanation: Certain individuals and income types are exempt from tax. Minimum wage earners, agricultural businesses (first 5 years), and military officers have specific exemptions.
questions.helpText: Select all that apply. These exemptions may reduce or eliminate your tax liability.

note: After these base questions, the system will ask detailed questions based on the answers. NIN/TIN collection happens after base questions are completed, before detailed income/deduction collection.
